306	    `;
307	    controlsEl.classList.remove("hidden");
308	  }
309	  function hideControls() {
310	    controlsLocked = null;
311	    controlsEl?.classList.add("hidden");
312	  }
313	
314	  function setModelOpacity(model, o) {
315	    model.traverse((n) => {
316	      if (n.material) { n.material.transparent = o < 1; n.material.opacity = o; }
317	    });
318	  }
319	
320	  // ---------- terminal ----------
321	  function currentStep() {
322	    if (reviewMode) return REVIEW_STEP;
323	    if (!termTarget) return null;
324	    return STEPS[termTarget.state] || null;
325	  }
326	  function renderTerminal() {
327	    const step = currentStep();
328	    if (!step) return;
329	
330	    if (reviewMode && listShown) {
331	      termHint.textContent = "# entire checkpoint list";
332	      termInput.textContent = "entire checkpoint list";
333	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
334	      termList?.classList.remove("hidden");
335	      return;
336	    }
337	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
338	
339	    const tail = step.type === "command" ? `type:  ${step.cmd}` : "press y / n";
340	    termHint.textContent = step.hint ? `# ${step.hint}   ·   ${tail}` : "";
341	    if (step.type === "confirm") {
342	      termInput.textContent = `${step.question}  [y/n]`;
343	      termInput.classList.add("is-dim");
344	    } else {
345	      termInput.textContent = buffer;
346	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
347	    }
348	  }
349	  function flashTerminal(text, ok) {
350	    if (!termMsg) return;
351	    clearTimeout(msgTimer);
352	    termMsg.textContent = text;
353	    termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
354	    termMsg.classList.add(ok ? "show-ok" : "show-err");
355	    msgTimer = setTimeout(() => termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err"), 2400);
356	  }
357	  function openTerminal(a) {
358	    if (terminalOpen) return;
359	    terminalOpen = true;
360	    termTarget = a;
361	    buffer = "";
362	    fp.detach();                      // freeze movement; keystrokes feed the terminal
363	    termMsg?.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
364	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
365	    termEl?.classList.remove("hidden");
366	    renderTerminal();
367	  }
368	  function closeTerminal(dismiss) {
369	    if (!terminalOpen) return;
370	    if (dismiss && termTarget) dismissedMemory = termTarget;
371	    terminalOpen = false;
372	    termTarget = null;
373	    buffer = "";
374	    termEl?.classList.add("hidden");
375	    if (active) fp.attach();          // resume walking (addEventListener dedupes)
376	  }
377	  function submitCommand() {
378	    const step = currentStep();
379	    if (!step || step.type !== "command" || listShown) return;
380	    if (cmdMatches(buffer, step.accept)) {
381	      buffer = "";
382	      if (reviewMode) { showCheckpointList(); return; }
383	      runStep(termTarget);            // dormant → stage, recovered → commit
384	      flashTerminal("✓ ok", true);
385	      renderTerminal();
386	    } else {
387	      flashTerminal(`command not recognized — try:  ${step.cmd}`, false);
388	      buffer = "";
389	      renderTerminal();
390	    }
391	  }
392	  function showCheckpointList() {
393	    listShown = true;
394	    if (termList) {
395	      termList.innerHTML = artifacts.map((a) =>
396	        `<div class="term-list-row"><span class="tl-id">${a.id}</span>` +
397	        `<span class="tl-title">recovered: ${a.fragment.title}</span></div>`
398	      ).join("");
399	    }
400	    flashTerminal(`${artifacts.length} checkpoints linked · ship fully restored`, true);
401	    showTutorial("Ship fully restored. Press Esc to close the terminal, then B to return to orbit.", 0);
402	    renderTerminal();
403	  }
404	
405	  // ---------- state transitions ----------
406	  function runStep(a) {
407	    if (a.state === "dormant") stage(a);
408	    else if (a.state === "recovered") commit(a);
409	  }
410	  function stage(a) {
411	    a.state = "recovered";
412	    a.fadeT = FADE_TIME;
413	    teachOnce("staged",
414	      "Staged — but uncommitted work can still be lost. Run `git commit` before it fades.");
415	  }
416	  function destabilize(a) {
417	    a.state = "dormant";
418	    a.fadeT = 0;
419	    setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
420	    if (termTarget === a) renderTerminal();
421	    showTutorial("The staged memory slipped away. Run `git add` again to recover it.", 3000);
422	  }
423	  function commit(a) {
424	    a.state = "frozen";
425	    setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
426	    const ice = makeIceBlock();
427	    ice.position.y = a.model.position.y + 0.6;
428	    a.iceY = ice.position.y;
429	    a.anchor.add(ice);
430	    a.ice = ice;
431	    teachOnce("committed",
432	      "Committed and frozen — locked in. Now Entire offers to link a checkpoint: press y to capture the session behind this commit.");
433	  }
434	  function confirmCheckpoint(yes) {
435	    const a = termTarget;
436	    if (!a || a.state !== "frozen") return;
437	    if (!yes) {
438	      flashTerminal("declined — without a checkpoint the ship can't track this commit. re-approach to link it.", false);
439	      closeTerminal(true);
440	      return;
441	    }
442	    checkpoint(a);
443	    if (allLinked()) {
444	      reviewMode = true;
445	      shipMeter?.classList.add("is-full");
446	      showTutorial("All memories recovered! Run `entire checkpoint list` to review everything you've banked.", 0);
447	      renderTerminal();              // stay open → review step
448	    } else {
449	      closeTerminal(false);
450	    }
451	  }
452	  function checkpoint(a) {
453	    a.state = "checkpointed";
454	    a.id = genCheckpointId();
455	    const shipPct = 62 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 23); // 62–84%
456	
457	    if (a.ice) {
458	      a.ice.material.emissive.setHex(0x2a6c8a);
459	      a.ice.material.emissiveIntensity = 1.1;
460	      const core = new THREE.PointLight(0x8fe3ff, 6, 26, 2);
461	      core.position.copy(a.ice.position);
462	      a.anchor.add(core);
463	    }
464	    const spr = makeIdSprite(a.id);
465	    spr.position.y = a.iceY + 5;
466	    a.anchor.add(spr);
467	    a.idSprite = spr;
468	
469	    showCard(a, shipPct);
470	    setPower();
471	    teachOnce("checkpointed",
472	      "Checkpoint linked — Entire stamps it onto the commit via an `Entire-checkpoint` trailer, and ship power rose.");
473	  }
474	
475	  // ---------- input ----------
476	  function onCanvasClick() {
477	    if (active && !fp.isLocked) fp.lock();
478	  }
479	  function onKeyDown(e) {
480	    if (!active) return;
481	
482	    // While the terminal is open, all keys feed it.
483	    if (terminalOpen) {
484	      if (e.code === "Escape") { closeTerminal(true); e.preventDefault(); return; }
485	      if (reviewMode && listShown) { e.preventDefault(); return; } // only Esc closes the list
486	
487	      const step = currentStep();
488	      if (step?.type === "confirm") {
489	        if (e.key === "y" || e.key === "Y") { confirmCheckpoint(true); e.preventDefault(); return; }
490	        if (e.key === "n" || e.key === "N") { confirmCheckpoint(false); e.preventDefault(); return; }
491	        e.preventDefault();
492	        return;
493	      }
494	      // command mode
495	      if (e.code === "Enter") { submitCommand(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
496	      if (e.code === "Backspace") { buffer = buffer.slice(0, -1); renderTerminal(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
497	      if (e.key && e.key.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {
498	        buffer += e.key;
499	        renderTerminal();
500	        e.preventDefault();
501	      }
502	      return;
503	    }
504	
505	    // Walking around (terminal closed).
506	    if (e.code === "Escape" && fp.isLocked) fp.unlock();
507	    if (e.code === "KeyB") onExit?.();
508	  }
509	  fp.controls.addEventListener("lock", () => crosshair?.classList.remove("hidden"));
510	  fp.controls.addEventListener("unlock", () => crosshair?.classList.add("hidden"));
511	
512	  // ---------- HUD per-frame ----------
513	  function refreshHud() {
514	    if (terminalOpen) {
515	      setPrompt(null);
516	      hideControls();
517	      if (termTarget && termTarget.state === "recovered") showFadeBar(termTarget.fadeT / FADE_TIME);
518	      else hideActionBar();
519	      return;
520	    }
521	    setControls(fp.isLocked);
522	    hideActionBar();
523	    if (!fp.isLocked) { setPrompt("Click to look around"); return; }
524	    if (allLinked()) { setPrompt("Ship fully restored — press B to return to orbit"); return; }
525	    setPrompt("Find the surfacing memory");
526	  }
527	
528	  // ---------- per-frame ----------
529	  function update(dt, t) {
530	    fp.update(dt);
531	
532	    // Nearest memory within reach (ignoring height).
533	    let nearest = null, nd = Infinity;
534	    for (const a of artifacts) {
535	      const dx = camera.position.x - a.anchor.position.x;
536	      const dz = camera.position.z - a.anchor.position.z;
537	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
538	      if (d < nd) { nd = d; nearest = a; }
539	    }
540	    target = nd <= INTERACT_DIST ? nearest : null;
541	
542	    // Auto open/close the ship's terminal as you reach a memory.
543	    // (In review mode the terminal is driven manually, so leave it alone.)
544	    if (active && !reviewMode) {
545	      if (dismissedMemory && target !== dismissedMemory) dismissedMemory = null;
546	      const canOpen = target && target.state !== "checkpointed" && target !== dismissedMemory;
547	      if (canOpen && !terminalOpen) openTerminal(target);
548	      else if (!canOpen && terminalOpen) closeTerminal(false);
549	    }
550	
551	    for (const a of artifacts) {
552	      const encased = a.state === "frozen" || a.state === "checkpointed";
553	
554	      // Idle spin/bob until the memory is encased in ice.
555	      if (!encased) {
556	        a.model.rotation.y += dt * 0.6;
557	        a.model.position.y = 1.4 + Math.sin((t + a.bobOff) * 1.5) * 0.4;
558	      }
559	
560	      // A staged (added) but uncommitted memory fades until it destabilizes.
561	      if (a.state === "recovered") {
562	        a.fadeT -= dt;
563	        setModelOpacity(a.model, 0.25 + 0.75 * Math.max(0, a.fadeT / FADE_TIME));
564	        if (a.fadeT <= 0) destabilize(a);
565	      } else if (a.state === "dormant") {
566	        setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
567	      }
568	
569	      // Beam + glow: bright while findable, gone once frozen.
570	      const lit = a.state === "dormant" || a.state === "recovered";
571	      let o = 0;
572	      if (a.state === "dormant") o = 0.4 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.12;
573	      else if (a.state === "recovered") o = 0.22;
574	      a.beam.material.opacity = o;
575	      a.beam.visible = o > 0.01;
576	      a.glow.visible = lit;
577	    }
578	
579	    if (terminalOpen) renderTerminal(); // reflect fade-driven state changes
580	    if (active) refreshHud();
581	  }
582	
583	  // ---------- lifecycle ----------
584	  function enter() {
585	    active = true;
586	    fp.attach();
587	    fp.groundAt(0, terrain.radius * 0.75);
588	    camera.lookAt(0, terrain.heightAt(0, 0) + 6, 0);
589	    canvas.addEventListener("click", onCanvasClick);
590	    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
591	    islandHud?.classList.remove("hidden");
592	    setControls(false);
593	    crosshair?.classList.add("hidden");
594	    setPower();
595	    if (!allLinked()) {
596	      showTutorial("A memory is surfacing nearby — walk up to it to open the ship's terminal.", 6500);
597	    } else {
598	      showTutorial("Ship fully restored — press B to return to orbit.", 0);
599	    }
600	  }
601	  function exit() {
602	    active = false;
603	    closeTerminal(false);
604	    fp.unlock();
605	    fp.detach();
606	    canvas.removeEventListener("click", onCanvasClick);
607	    window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
608	    setPrompt(null);
609	    hideControls();
610	    hideActionBar();
611	    tutorialEl?.classList.add("hidden");
612	    ckptCard?.classList.add("hidden");
613	    termEl?.classList.add("hidden");
614	    islandHud?.classList.add("hidden");
615	    crosshair?.classList.add("hidden");
616	  }
617	  function resize() {
618	    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
619	    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
620	  }
621	
622	  return { scene, camera, update, enter, exit, resize };
623	}

Done. Swapped the per-memory fade for one level-wide countdown, exactly as you described.

**What changed**
- **One countdown clock** (top-left, `TIME 1:15`) runs for the whole run — not per-item. It ticks down the entire time you're gathering, turns **red and pulses under 15s**, stops the instant all three are banked, and pauses while you're in orbit.
- **No more individual fading.** Staged/committed memories just sit there now; the clock is the only pressure.
- **Run out of time → everything un-banked melts** (sinks + fades, ice included) and a **"MEMORIES MELTED"** screen comes up: *press R to try again* (full reset, movement frozen behind it).
- Difficulty is `TOTAL_TIME` — set to **75s for 3 memories**. It's a one-line tune at the top of `islandView.js`; play it and we'll dial it in.

**Verified headless** (swiftshader Chrome): clock visible and ticking `1:15 → 1:13 → 1:09…`; timeout → `0:00` + fail screen; `R` → fresh run at full time, fail screen gone. Only the pre-existing favicon 404, no JS errors. Clean `vite build`, temp test-timer reverted, puppeteer removed. PLAN.md + memory updated.

75s is my opening guess at "fast-but-fair" — walking between the three placements plus typing the commands. Run `npm run dev` and see if it feels like the right amount of squeeze; easy to nudge up or down.

Done. The `entire checkpoint list` is now the real, timed finish line.

**What changed**
- Banking the last memory no longer stops the clock — it keeps ticking (and still escalates red/critical) while you race to type `entire checkpoint list`.
- The clock stops **only** when the list actually shows. Win is now keyed on that, not on "all banked."
- You **can't Esc** out of that final review prompt — no dodging the clock.
- If you run out the clock during the review (everything banked but list not typed), the **whole run melts** — fail screen, `R` to retry.
- Leaving to orbit mid-review pauses the clock and reopens the review prompt when you come back.

- Timing out during review → fail screen even at 100% power; `R` → fresh run, power back to 0%, terminal back at `git add`.

  "new_string": "  function updateClock() {\n    if (countdownTime) countdownTime.textContent = fmtTime(timeLeft);\n    countdownEl?.classList.toggle(\"is-low\", timerRunning && timeLeft <= LOW_TIME);\n    countdownEl?.classList.toggle(\"is-critical\", timerRunning && timeLeft <= CRIT_TIME);\n  }\n\n  // How hard the sky is panicking right now: 0 = calm lavender, 1 = full crimson throb.\n  function panicFactor() {\n    if (failed) return 1;                         // hold the dread behind the fail screen\n    if (!timerRunning || timeLeft > PANIC_TIME) return 0;\n    let p = (PANIC_TIME - timeLeft) / PANIC_TIME; // 0 at PANIC_TIME → 1 at 0:00\n    p *= p;                                        // eased: barely there early, harsh late\n    if (timeLeft <= CRIT_TIME) {                   // throb once it's critical\n      const throb = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 85);\n      p += 0.14 * throb;\n    }\n    return Math.min(1, p);\n  }\n  function applyPanicSky() {\n    const p = panicFactor();\n    scene.background.copy(SKY_CALM).lerp(SKY_PANIC, p);\n    scene.fog.color.copy(SKY_CALM).lerp(FOG_PANIC, p);\n    dome.material.color.copy(DOME_CALM).lerp(DOME_PANIC, p);\n    sun.color.copy(SUN_CALM).lerp(SUN_PANIC, p * 0.85);\n  }"
}

> AGENT

Done. The whole world now panics as the clock runs out, not just the HUD.

**What I built**
- Starting at **22s** (`PANIC_TIME`), the sky, fog, dome, and sun lerp from the calm lavender dusk toward an angry **crimson**.
- The ramp is **eased** (`p²`) — barely perceptible at first, so the calm mood owns most of the run and the red only really lands in the final ~10 seconds.
- Once **critical (under 8s)** the sky **throbs**, and it holds full blood-red behind the "MEMORIES MELTED" fail screen.
- It's its own knob (`PANIC_TIME`), separate from the clock's red states, so you can move the sky's onset without touching the clock.

**Verified visually** (screenshots): calm lavender at the start → deep crimson sky with red-lit dunes in the final seconds → full blood-red on fail. HUD stays readable throughout. Clean build; temp edits reverted, puppeteer removed.

On your "what time is appropriate" question — I went with 22s because it makes the whole experience escalate in one coherent wave (clock + sky together), but the easing means it doesn't *feel* like it starts until the last third. If you'd rather the sky stay totally untouched until the panic really hits, bump `PANIC_TIME` down to ~14 — then calm holds longer and the red slams in harder and later. Worth feeling both in `npm run dev` before deciding.

  "new_string": "// Floating label above a frozen block — the commit trailer Entire stamps on:\n//   \"Entire-Checkpoint: <12-char hash>\" (dim key + bright hash).\nfunction makeIdSprite(id) {\n  const c = document.createElement(\"canvas\");\n  c.width = 768; c.height = 64;\n  const ctx = c.getContext(\"2d\");\n  ctx.font = \"bold 28px ui-monospace, monospace\";\n  ctx.textBaseline = \"middle\";\n  ctx.shadowColor = \"rgba(111,227,255,0.9)\";\n  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;\n\n  const key = \"Entire-Checkpoint: \";\n  const keyW = ctx.measureText(key).width;\n  const idW = ctx.measureText(id).width;\n  let x = (c.width - (keyW + idW)) / 2;       // center the whole trailer\n  ctx.textAlign = \"left\";\n  ctx.fillStyle = \"#8fc4dc\";                    // dim trailer key\n  ctx.fillText(key, x, 34);\n  ctx.fillStyle = \"#dff3ff\";                    // bright hash\n  ctx.fillText(id, x + keyW, 34);\n\n  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);\n  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;\n  const spr = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({\n    map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, fog: false,\n  }));\n  spr.scale.set(30, 2.5, 1);                    // 12:1 canvas → keep text height\n  return spr;"
}

Good catch — that wording is a little redundant, and here's the actual behavior:

**Memories only melt at 0:00.** There's no individual/early melting anymore — that was the old per-memory fade we ripped out. Now there's just the one level clock, and melting is purely the *failure animation* that plays when the clock hits zero.

So in that line — *"Bank all three before 0:00 or they melt!"* — "before 0:00" and "they melt" are the **same moment**, not two different deadlines. It reads like there might be an earlier melt threshold, but there isn't. The melt *is* what hitting 0:00 looks like:

- Clock reaches **0:00** → run fails → every un-banked memory melts (sinks + fades, ice included) → "MEMORIES MELTED" screen → `R` to retry.
- If you bank all three *and* type `entire checkpoint list` before 0:00 → you win, nothing melts.

So nothing melts mid-run while the clock's still going — a staged or committed-but-not-checkpointed memory just sits there safely until the deadline.

You said not to change anything, so I'll leave it — but if that phrasing bugs you, the cleanest fix would be to just say *"Bank all three before 0:00!"* and let the melt be the surprise payoff when you fail. Your call.

109	  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(111,227,255,0.9)";
110	  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
111	
112	  const key = "Entire-Checkpoint: ";
113	  const keyW = ctx.measureText(key).width;
114	  const idW = ctx.measureText(id).width;
115	  let x = (c.width - (keyW + idW)) / 2;       // center the whole trailer
116	  ctx.textAlign = "left";
117	  ctx.fillStyle = "#8fc4dc";                    // dim trailer key
118	  ctx.fillText(key, x, 34);
119	  ctx.fillStyle = "#dff3ff";                    // bright hash
120	  ctx.fillText(id, x + keyW, 34);
121	
122	  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
123	  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
124	  const spr = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
125	    map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, fog: false,
126	  }));
127	  spr.scale.set(30, 2.5, 1);                    // 12:1 canvas → keep text height
128	  return spr;
129	}
130	
131	// Entire checkpoints get a 12-character hex id (e.g. 711044b1fe29).
132	function genCheckpointId() {
133	  const hex = "0123456789abcdef";
134	  let s = "";
135	  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) s += hex[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)];
136	  return s;
137	}
138	
139	export function createIslandView(renderer, { onExit } = {}) {
140	  const canvas = renderer.domElement;
141	
142	  // ---------- scene & sky ----------
143	  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
144	  scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x2a2350); // lavender dusk sky
145	  scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x2a2350, 90, 320);
146	
147	  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
148	    62, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 2000
149	  );
150	
151	  // ---------- lighting (soft, warm sun in a lavender sky) ----------
152	  scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xcdbcff, 0x3a2f5e, 0.7));
153	  const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1dc, 1.5);
154	  sun.position.set(60, 90, 40);
155	  scene.add(sun);
156	  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x6a5a92, 0.3));
157	
158	  const dome = new THREE.Mesh(
159	    new THREE.SphereGeometry(900, 32, 16),
160	    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x3a3168, side: THREE.BackSide, fog: false })
161	  );
162	  scene.add(dome);
163	
164	  // ---------- terrain ----------
165	  const terrain = createTerrain({ size: 200, segments: 220, maxHeight: 26, seed: 1337 });
166	  scene.add(terrain.mesh, terrain.water);
167	
168	  // ---------- memories ----------
169	  const beamTex = makeBeamTexture();
170	  const artifacts = [];
171	  FRAGMENTS.slice(0, MEMORY_COUNT).forEach((frag, idx) => {
172	    const place = PLACEMENTS[idx % PLACEMENTS.length];
173	    const groundY = terrain.heightAt(place.x, place.z);
174	    const anchor = new THREE.Group();
175	    anchor.position.set(place.x, groundY, place.z);
176	
177	    const model = BUILDERS[frag.kind]();
178	    model.scale.setScalar(14);
179	    model.position.y = 1.4;
180	    anchor.add(model);
181	
182	    // A tall light beam so the memory is findable from across the island.
183	    const beam = new THREE.Mesh(
184	      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6, 0.6, 60, 12, 1, true),
185	      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
186	        map: beamTex, color: BEAM_COLOR, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5,
187	        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,
188	        fog: false,
189	      })
190	    );
191	    beam.position.y = 30;
192	    anchor.add(beam);
193	
194	    const glow = new THREE.PointLight(BEAM_COLOR, 8, 40, 2);
195	    glow.position.y = 3;
196	    anchor.add(glow);
197	
198	    scene.add(anchor);
199	    artifacts.push({
200	      anchor, model, beam, glow, fragment: frag,
201	      state: "dormant",   // dormant → recovered (staged) → frozen (committed) → checkpointed
202	      ice: null, idSprite: null, core: null, id: null, iceY: 0,
203	      melting: false, meltT: 0,   // melt-away animation when the level times out
204	      bobOff: Math.random() * 10,
205	    });
206	  });
207	
208	  // ---------- first-person controller ----------
209	  const fp = createFirstPerson(camera, canvas, {
210	    heightAt: terrain.heightAt,
211	    radius: terrain.radius * 0.96,
212	    eyeHeight: 2.6,
213	    speed: 24,
214	  });
215	  scene.add(fp.controls.object);
216	
217	  // ---------- HUD elements ----------
218	  const promptEl = document.getElementById("fp-prompt");
219	  const controlsEl = document.getElementById("fp-controls");
220	  const crosshair = document.getElementById("crosshair");
221	  const islandHud = document.getElementById("island-hud");
222	  const tutorialEl = document.getElementById("tutorial");
223	  const actionBar = document.getElementById("action-bar");
224	  const actionBarFill = document.getElementById("action-bar-fill");
225	  const shipMeter = document.getElementById("ship-meter");
226	  const shipMeterFill = document.getElementById("ship-meter-fill");
227	  const shipMeterPct = document.getElementById("ship-meter-pct");
228	  const ckptCard = document.getElementById("ckpt-card");
229	  const ccId = document.getElementById("cc-id");
230	  const ccSummary = document.getElementById("cc-summary");
231	  const ccAttrFill = document.getElementById("cc-attr-fill");
232	  const ccAttrText = document.getElementById("cc-attr-text");
233	  const termEl = document.getElementById("terminal");
234	  const termHint = document.getElementById("term-hint");
235	  const termInput = document.getElementById("term-input");
236	  const termList = document.getElementById("term-list");
237	  const termMsg = document.getElementById("term-msg");
238	  const countdownEl = document.getElementById("countdown");
239	  const countdownTime = document.getElementById("countdown-time");
240	  const levelFail = document.getElementById("level-fail");
241	
242	  let target = null;            // nearest memory in range
243	  let active = false;           // is this view being shown?
244	  let promptText = null;
245	  let controlsLocked = null;
246	  const taught = new Set();
247	  let tutorialTimer = null;
248	  let cardTimer = null;
249	  let msgTimer = null;
250	
251	  // Terminal state
252	  let terminalOpen = false;
253	  let termTarget = null;        // the memory whose terminal is open
254	  let buffer = "";              // what the player has typed
255	  let dismissedMemory = null;   // memory the player Esc'd out of (until they leave)
256	  let reviewMode = false;       // all linked → review with `entire checkpoint list`
257	  let listShown = false;        // the list has been printed
258	
259	  // Level countdown — the single source of pressure for the whole run.
260	  let timeLeft = TOTAL_TIME;
261	  let timerRunning = false;
262	  let failed = false;
263	
264	  const checkpointedCount = () =>
265	    artifacts.filter((a) => a.state === "checkpointed").length;
266	  const allLinked = () => checkpointedCount() >= artifacts.length;
267	
268	  // ---------- HUD helpers ----------
269	  function setPrompt(text) {
270	    if (!promptEl || text === promptText) return;
271	    promptText = text;
272	    if (text) { promptEl.textContent = text; promptEl.classList.remove("hidden"); }
273	    else promptEl.classList.add("hidden");
274	  }
275	  function hideActionBar() { actionBar.classList.add("hidden"); }
276	
277	  // ---------- level countdown ----------
278	  function fmtTime(s) {
279	    s = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(s));
280	    return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
281	  }
282	  function updateClock() {
283	    if (countdownTime) countdownTime.textContent = fmtTime(timeLeft);
284	    countdownEl?.classList.toggle("is-low", timerRunning && timeLeft <= LOW_TIME);
285	    countdownEl?.classList.toggle("is-critical", timerRunning && timeLeft <= CRIT_TIME);
286	  }
287	
288	  // How hard the sky is panicking right now: 0 = calm lavender, 1 = full crimson throb.
289	  function panicFactor() {
290	    if (failed) return 1;                         // hold the dread behind the fail screen
291	    if (!timerRunning || timeLeft > PANIC_TIME) return 0;
292	    let p = (PANIC_TIME - timeLeft) / PANIC_TIME; // 0 at PANIC_TIME → 1 at 0:00
293	    p *= p;                                        // eased: barely there early, harsh late
294	    if (timeLeft <= CRIT_TIME) {                   // throb once it's critical
295	      const throb = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(performance.now() / 85);
296	      p += 0.14 * throb;
297	    }
298	    return Math.min(1, p);
299	  }
300	  function applyPanicSky() {
301	    const p = panicFactor();
302	    scene.background.copy(SKY_CALM).lerp(SKY_PANIC, p);
303	    scene.fog.color.copy(SKY_CALM).lerp(FOG_PANIC, p);
304	    dome.material.color.copy(DOME_CALM).lerp(DOME_PANIC, p);
305	    sun.color.copy(SUN_CALM).lerp(SUN_PANIC, p * 0.85);
306	  }
307	  function failLevel() {
308	    if (failed) return;
309	    failed = true;
310	    timerRunning = false;
311	    closeTerminal(false);
312	    fp.detach();                  // freeze the player behind the fail screen
313	    // Un-banked memories always melt; if they ran out the clock on the final
314	    // `entire checkpoint list` (all banked, not yet reviewed), the whole run melts.
315	    for (const a of artifacts) {
316	      if (reviewMode || a.state !== "checkpointed") { a.melting = true; a.meltT = MELT_DUR; }
317	    }
318	    countdownEl?.classList.remove("is-low", "is-critical");
319	    tutorialEl?.classList.add("hidden");
320	    levelFail?.classList.remove("hidden");
321	  }
322	  function resetLevel() {
323	    failed = false;
324	    levelFail?.classList.add("hidden");
325	    if (active) fp.attach();      // movement resumes for the new run
326	    for (const a of artifacts) {
327	      if (a.ice) { a.anchor.remove(a.ice); a.ice = null; }
328	      if (a.idSprite) { a.anchor.remove(a.idSprite); a.idSprite = null; }
329	      if (a.core) { a.anchor.remove(a.core); a.core = null; }
330	      a.state = "dormant";
331	      a.id = null;
332	      a.melting = false; a.meltT = 0;
333	      a.model.position.y = 1.4;
334	      setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
335	    }
336	    reviewMode = false;
337	    listShown = false;
338	    dismissedMemory = null;
339	    shipMeter?.classList.remove("is-full");
340	    setPower();
341	    timeLeft = TOTAL_TIME;
342	    timerRunning = true;
343	    updateClock();
344	    showTutorial("New attempt — bank all three memories before the clock hits zero.", 4500);
345	  }
346	
347	  function showTutorial(text, ms = 5500) {
348	    if (!tutorialEl) return;
349	    clearTimeout(tutorialTimer);
350	    tutorialEl.textContent = text;
351	    tutorialEl.classList.remove("hidden");
352	    if (ms > 0) tutorialTimer = setTimeout(() => tutorialEl.classList.add("hidden"), ms);
353	  }
354	  function teachOnce(key, text, ms) {
355	    if (taught.has(key)) return;
356	    taught.add(key);
357	    showTutorial(text, ms);
358	  }
359	
360	  function setPower() {
361	    const pct = Math.round((checkpointedCount() / artifacts.length) * 100);
362	    if (shipMeterFill) shipMeterFill.style.width = pct + "%";
363	    if (shipMeterPct) shipMeterPct.textContent = pct + "%";
364	  }
365	  function showCard(a, shipPct) {
366	    if (!ckptCard) return;
367	    ccId.textContent = a.id;
368	    ccSummary.textContent = `Recovered: ${a.fragment.title}`;
369	    ccAttrFill.style.width = shipPct + "%";
370	    ccAttrText.textContent = `ship ${shipPct}% · you ${100 - shipPct}%`;
371	    ckptCard.classList.remove("hidden");
372	    clearTimeout(cardTimer);
373	    cardTimer = setTimeout(() => ckptCard.classList.add("hidden"), 3800);
374	  }
375	
376	  function setControls(locked) {
377	    if (!controlsEl) return;
378	    if (locked === controlsLocked && !controlsEl.classList.contains("hidden")) return;
379	    controlsLocked = locked;
380	    controlsEl.innerHTML = `
381	      <span class="control-item">
382	        <span class="control-label">To move</span>
383	        <span class="arrow-keys" aria-label="Arrow keys">
384	          <span class="key key-up">↑</span>
385	          <span class="key key-left">←</span>
386	          <span class="key key-down">↓</span>
387	          <span class="key key-right">→</span>
388	        </span>
389	      </span>
390	      ${locked ? `
391	        <span class="control-item">
392	          <span class="control-label">To look around</span>
393	          <span class="mouse-hint">
394	            <span class="mouse-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
395	            <span>move mouse</span>
396	          </span>
397	        </span>
398	      ` : ""}
399	      <span class="control-item">
400	        <span class="control-label">Return to orbit</span>
401	        <span class="key">B</span>
402	      </span>
403	    `;
404	    controlsEl.classList.remove("hidden");
405	  }
406	  function hideControls() {
407	    controlsLocked = null;
408	    controlsEl?.classList.add("hidden");
409	  }
410	
411	  function setModelOpacity(model, o) {
412	    model.traverse((n) => {
413	      if (n.material) { n.material.transparent = o < 1; n.material.opacity = o; }
414	    });
415	  }
416	
417	  // ---------- terminal ----------
418	  function currentStep() {
419	    if (reviewMode) return REVIEW_STEP;
420	    if (!termTarget) return null;
421	    return STEPS[termTarget.state] || null;
422	  }
423	  function renderTerminal() {
424	    const step = currentStep();
425	    if (!step) return;
426	
427	    if (reviewMode && listShown) {
428	      termHint.textContent = "# entire checkpoint list";
429	      termInput.textContent = "entire checkpoint list";
430	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
431	      termList?.classList.remove("hidden");
432	      return;
433	    }
434	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
435	
436	    const tail = step.type === "command" ? `type:  ${step.cmd}` : "press y / n";
437	    termHint.textContent = step.hint ? `# ${step.hint}   ·   ${tail}` : "";
438	    if (step.type === "confirm") {
439	      termInput.textContent = `${step.question}  [y/n]`;
440	      termInput.classList.add("is-dim");
441	    } else {
442	      termInput.textContent = buffer;
443	      termInput.classList.remove("is-dim");
444	    }
445	  }
446	  function flashTerminal(text, ok) {
447	    if (!termMsg) return;
448	    clearTimeout(msgTimer);
449	    termMsg.textContent = text;
450	    termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
451	    termMsg.classList.add(ok ? "show-ok" : "show-err");
452	    msgTimer = setTimeout(() => termMsg.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err"), 2400);
453	  }
454	  function openTerminal(a) {
455	    if (terminalOpen) return;
456	    terminalOpen = true;
457	    termTarget = a;
458	    buffer = "";
459	    fp.detach();                      // freeze movement; keystrokes feed the terminal
460	    termMsg?.classList.remove("show-ok", "show-err");
461	    termList?.classList.add("hidden");
462	    termEl?.classList.remove("hidden");
463	    renderTerminal();
464	  }
465	  function closeTerminal(dismiss) {
466	    if (!terminalOpen) return;
467	    if (dismiss && termTarget) dismissedMemory = termTarget;
468	    terminalOpen = false;
469	    termTarget = null;
470	    buffer = "";
471	    termEl?.classList.add("hidden");
472	    if (active) fp.attach();          // resume walking (addEventListener dedupes)
473	  }
474	  function submitCommand() {
475	    const step = currentStep();
476	    if (!step || step.type !== "command" || listShown) return;
477	    if (cmdMatches(buffer, step.accept)) {
478	      buffer = "";
479	      if (reviewMode) { showCheckpointList(); return; }
480	      runStep(termTarget);            // dormant → stage, recovered → commit
481	      flashTerminal("✓ ok", true);
482	      renderTerminal();
483	    } else {
484	      flashTerminal(`command not recognized — try:  ${step.cmd}`, false);
485	      buffer = "";
486	      renderTerminal();
487	    }
488	  }
489	  function showCheckpointList() {
490	    listShown = true;
491	    timerRunning = false;            // the run is complete — NOW the clock stops
492	    countdownEl?.classList.remove("is-low", "is-critical");
493	    if (termList) {
494	      termList.innerHTML = artifacts.map((a) =>
495	        `<div class="term-list-row"><span class="tl-id">` +
496	        `<span class="tl-key">Entire-Checkpoint:</span> ${a.id}</span>` +
497	        `<span class="tl-title">recovered: ${a.fragment.title}</span></div>`
498	      ).join("");
499	    }
500	    flashTerminal(`${artifacts.length} checkpoints linked · ship fully restored`, true);
501	    showTutorial("Ship fully restored. Press Esc to close the terminal, then B to return to orbit.", 0);
502	    renderTerminal();
503	  }
504	
505	  // ---------- state transitions ----------
506	  function runStep(a) {
507	    if (a.state === "dormant") stage(a);
508	    else if (a.state === "recovered") commit(a);
509	  }
510	  function stage(a) {
511	    a.state = "recovered";
512	    teachOnce("staged",
513	      "Recovered and staged. Run `git commit` to freeze it — the clock is ticking.");
514	  }
515	  function commit(a) {
516	    a.state = "frozen";
517	    setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
518	    const ice = makeIceBlock();
519	    ice.position.y = a.model.position.y + 0.6;
520	    a.iceY = ice.position.y;
521	    a.anchor.add(ice);
522	    a.ice = ice;
523	    teachOnce("committed",
524	      "Committed and frozen — locked in. Now Entire offers to link a checkpoint: press y to capture the session behind this commit.");
525	  }
526	  function confirmCheckpoint(yes) {
527	    const a = termTarget;
528	    if (!a || a.state !== "frozen") return;
529	    if (!yes) {
530	      flashTerminal("declined — without a checkpoint the ship can't track this commit. re-approach to link it.", false);
531	      closeTerminal(true);
532	      return;
533	    }
534	    checkpoint(a);
535	    if (allLinked()) {
536	      reviewMode = true;             // clock KEEPS running — the list is the finish line
537	      shipMeter?.classList.add("is-full");
538	      showTutorial("All banked! Now type `entire checkpoint list` before the clock hits 0:00 — hurry!", 0);
539	      renderTerminal();              // stay open → review step
540	    } else {
541	      closeTerminal(false);
542	    }
543	  }
544	  function checkpoint(a) {
545	    a.state = "checkpointed";
546	    a.id = genCheckpointId();
547	    const shipPct = 62 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 23); // 62–84%
548	
549	    if (a.ice) {
550	      a.ice.material.emissive.setHex(0x2a6c8a);
551	      a.ice.material.emissiveIntensity = 1.1;
552	      const core = new THREE.PointLight(0x8fe3ff, 6, 26, 2);
553	      core.position.copy(a.ice.position);
554	      a.anchor.add(core);
555	      a.core = core;
556	    }
557	    const spr = makeIdSprite(a.id);
558	    spr.position.y = a.iceY + 5;
559	    a.anchor.add(spr);
560	    a.idSprite = spr;
561	
562	    showCard(a, shipPct);
563	    setPower();
564	    teachOnce("checkpointed",
565	      "Checkpoint linked — Entire stamps it onto the commit via an `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer, and ship power rose.");
566	  }
567	
568	  // ---------- input ----------
569	  function onCanvasClick() {
570	    if (active && !fp.isLocked) fp.lock();
571	  }
572	  function onKeyDown(e) {
573	    if (!active) return;
574	
575	    // The run failed — only R (retry) does anything.
576	    if (failed) {
577	      if (e.code === "KeyR") { resetLevel(); e.preventDefault(); }
578	      return;
579	    }
580	
581	    // While the terminal is open, all keys feed it.
582	    if (terminalOpen) {
583	      if (e.code === "Escape") {
584	        // No bailing on the final review — the clock is still ticking.
585	        if (reviewMode && !listShown) { e.preventDefault(); return; }
586	        closeTerminal(true); e.preventDefault(); return;
587	      }
588	      if (reviewMode && listShown) { e.preventDefault(); return; } // only Esc closes the list
589	
590	      const step = currentStep();
591	      if (step?.type === "confirm") {
592	        if (e.key === "y" || e.key === "Y") { confirmCheckpoint(true); e.preventDefault(); return; }
593	        if (e.key === "n" || e.key === "N") { confirmCheckpoint(false); e.preventDefault(); return; }
594	        e.preventDefault();
595	        return;
596	      }
597	      // command mode
598	      if (e.code === "Enter") { submitCommand(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
599	      if (e.code === "Backspace") { buffer = buffer.slice(0, -1); renderTerminal(); e.preventDefault(); return; }
600	      if (e.key && e.key.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) {
601	        buffer += e.key;
602	        renderTerminal();
603	        e.preventDefault();
604	      }
605	      return;
606	    }
607	
608	    // Walking around (terminal closed).
609	    if (e.code === "Escape" && fp.isLocked) fp.unlock();
610	    if (e.code === "KeyB") onExit?.();
611	  }
612	  fp.controls.addEventListener("lock", () => crosshair?.classList.remove("hidden"));
613	  fp.controls.addEventListener("unlock", () => crosshair?.classList.add("hidden"));
614	
615	  // ---------- HUD per-frame ----------
616	  function refreshHud() {
617	    if (terminalOpen) {
618	      setPrompt(null);
619	      hideControls();
620	      hideActionBar();
621	      return;
622	    }
623	    setControls(fp.isLocked);
624	    hideActionBar();
625	    if (!fp.isLocked) { setPrompt("Click to look around"); return; }
626	    if (listShown) { setPrompt("Ship fully restored — press B to return to orbit"); return; }
627	    setPrompt("Find the surfacing memory");
628	  }
629	
630	  // ---------- per-frame ----------
631	  function update(dt, t) {
632	    fp.update(dt);
633	
634	    // Level countdown — one clock for the whole run.
635	    if (active && timerRunning && !failed) {
636	      timeLeft = Math.max(0, timeLeft - dt);
637	      updateClock();
638	      if (timeLeft <= 0) failLevel();
639	    }
640	    applyPanicSky();   // the sky reacts to the clock every frame
641	
642	    // Nearest memory within reach (ignoring height).
643	    let nearest = null, nd = Infinity;
644	    for (const a of artifacts) {
645	      const dx = camera.position.x - a.anchor.position.x;
646	      const dz = camera.position.z - a.anchor.position.z;
647	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
648	      if (d < nd) { nd = d; nearest = a; }
649	    }
650	    target = nd <= INTERACT_DIST ? nearest : null;
651	
652	    // Auto open/close the ship's terminal as you reach a memory.
653	    // (In review mode the terminal is driven manually, so leave it alone.)
654	    if (active && !reviewMode && !failed) {
655	      if (dismissedMemory && target !== dismissedMemory) dismissedMemory = null;
656	      const canOpen = target && target.state !== "checkpointed" && target !== dismissedMemory;
657	      if (canOpen && !terminalOpen) openTerminal(target);
658	      else if (!canOpen && terminalOpen) closeTerminal(false);
659	    }
660	
661	    for (const a of artifacts) {
662	      // Melting away after a time-out — sink and fade, then disappear.
663	      if (a.melting) {
664	        a.meltT = Math.max(0, a.meltT - dt);
665	        const k = a.meltT / MELT_DUR;
666	        setModelOpacity(a.model, k);
667	        a.model.position.y -= dt * 2.4;
668	        if (a.ice) a.ice.material.opacity = 0.62 * k;
669	        a.beam.visible = false;
670	        a.glow.visible = false;
671	        continue;
672	      }
673	
674	      const encased = a.state === "frozen" || a.state === "checkpointed";
675	
676	      // Idle spin/bob until the memory is encased in ice.
677	      if (!encased) {
678	        a.model.rotation.y += dt * 0.6;
679	        a.model.position.y = 1.4 + Math.sin((t + a.bobOff) * 1.5) * 0.4;
680	        setModelOpacity(a.model, 1);
681	      }
682	
683	      // Beam + glow: bright while findable, gone once frozen.
684	      const lit = a.state === "dormant" || a.state === "recovered";
685	      let o = 0;
686	      if (a.state === "dormant") o = 0.4 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.12;
687	      else if (a.state === "recovered") o = 0.22;
688	      a.beam.material.opacity = o;
689	      a.beam.visible = o > 0.01;
690	      a.glow.visible = lit;
691	    }
692	
693	    if (terminalOpen) renderTerminal(); // reflect fade-driven state changes
694	    if (active) refreshHud();
695	  }
696	
697	  // ---------- lifecycle ----------
698	  function enter() {
699	    active = true;
700	    fp.attach();
701	    fp.groundAt(0, terrain.radius * 0.75);
702	    camera.lookAt(0, terrain.heightAt(0, 0) + 6, 0);
703	    canvas.addEventListener("click", onCanvasClick);
704	    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
705	    islandHud?.classList.remove("hidden");
706	    setControls(false);
707	    crosshair?.classList.add("hidden");
708	    setPower();
709	    if (listShown) {                // truly done — the list has been run
710	      timerRunning = false;
711	      showTutorial("Ship fully restored — press B to return to orbit.", 0);
712	    } else if (failed) {
713	      resetLevel();                 // came back after a wipe → fresh run
714	    } else {
715	      timerRunning = true;          // start (or resume) the level clock
716	      if (reviewMode) {             // resume the timed final review
717	        openTerminal(artifacts[0]); // termTarget unused in review; reopens the prompt
718	        showTutorial("Type `entire checkpoint list` before the clock hits 0:00!", 0);
719	      } else {
720	        showTutorial("Memories are surfacing — the clock's short. Bank all three before 0:00!", 6500);
721	      }
722	    }
723	    updateClock();
724	    applyPanicSky();   // start on the right sky (calm unless we resumed low on time)
725	  }
726	  function exit() {
727	    active = false;
728	    timerRunning = false;           // pause the clock while in orbit
729	    closeTerminal(false);
730	    fp.unlock();
731	    fp.detach();
732	    canvas.removeEventListener("click", onCanvasClick);
733	    window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
734	    setPrompt(null);
735	    hideControls();
736	    hideActionBar();
737	    tutorialEl?.classList.add("hidden");
738	    ckptCard?.classList.add("hidden");
739	    termEl?.classList.add("hidden");
740	    levelFail?.classList.add("hidden");
741	    islandHud?.classList.add("hidden");
742	    crosshair?.classList.add("hidden");
743	  }
744	  function resize() {
745	    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
746	    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
747	  }
748	
749	  return { scene, camera, update, enter, exit, resize };
750	}

> AGENT

Done. Here's the flow now:

**On landing** (click the island → crossfade), a briefing modal appears over a calm island backdrop. The clock is frozen at `0:45`, movement is disabled, and no terminals auto-open. The modal reads:

- **SIGNAL LOST · LEVEL 1 — First Memories**
- Story: *"You've crash-landed on a lavender world. Your ship's AI woke with no memory of the mission — and its memories are surfacing across this island. They won't hold for long."*
- **YOUR MISSION** (numbered): walk up to a memory → `git add` + `git commit` → press `y` to link a checkpoint → bank all three, then `entire checkpoint list` before `0:00`.
- A red warning about the countdown / panic sky / melting.
- A glowing **LAND & BEGIN** button (or press **Enter**).

**On Start** → modal fades, movement attaches, the clock resets to full and starts running, and the surfacing tutorial fires.

Key behaviors I made sure of:
- The briefing only shows on a **fresh landing**. If you duck back to orbit mid-run and return, it resumes (clock was paused in orbit) — no re-briefing. A failed run still goes straight to the retry/reset path.
- World clicks and gameplay keys are ignored while the briefing is up (only Enter/Space start it).
- New `started` flag gates the clock, movement, terminal auto-open, and walking HUD.

Build is clean. Worth a `npm run dev` playtest to feel the pacing — particularly whether the briefing copy length feels right before the 45s clock kicks in.

Want me to commit + checkpoint this once you've eyeballed it?

The established fiction (from PLAN.md) is solid: you're a stranded astronaut, and the **ship's** memory/log got wiped in the crash — recovering it in-fiction is the same act as recovering a codebase's history with Entire. So "ship's memory" is the right anchor, not your own.

The fix is to make the **crash** the cause: the impact scattered the ship's memory across the island as fragments, and you recover them to bring the ship back. That also ties straight into the gameplay (the glowing things you walk up to = those scattered fragments).

> **First Memories**
> You've crash-landed on a lavender world. The impact scattered your ship's memory across the island — fragments of the mission, surfacing in the dunes. Recover them before they're lost for good, and the ship comes back online.

> AGENT

L1's a great foundation to build on. Here's my take on where L2 naturally goes.

You deliberately left the **rewind** payoff out of L1 (it's in the "out of scope for L1" notes). That's exactly what L2 should be. In L1 you *banked* checkpoints — L2 is where you finally **use one to undo a disaster.**

The click moment for L2: **"checkpoints aren't just saved — they let you go back."** That's the thing that makes Entire feel like a superpower, and it only lands *after* L1 taught you to make them.

It teaches three more real Entire commands, all genuine:
- `entire checkpoint search "..."` — find a past checkpoint
- `entire checkpoint explain <id>` — see what that checkpoint actually was
- `entire checkpoint rewind --to <id>` — travel back to it

A fiction seed that fits the ship-memory world: you restored the ship's memory in L1, but one of those memories was **corrupted** — and now it's spreading, breaking systems as it goes. You have to find the last *good* checkpoint from before the corruption and rewind the ship to it.

Before I sketch any further, one fork in the road — which feels right to you?
